listeningQuestions.audio: A strong typhoon struck the southern coast last night.
opts: 昨晚一场强台风袭击了南部海岸。

listeningQuestions.audio: When you hear a flood warning, move to higher ground.
opts: 听到洪水警报时,要转移到高处。
听到洪水警报时,留在原地不动。
听到洪水警报时,跳进水里。
听到洪水警报时,先去睡觉。

listeningQuestions.audio: Cover your nose and mouth with a wet cloth in a wildfire.
opts: 野火中用湿布捂住口鼻。
野火中把窗户全部打开。

listeningQuestions.audio: A battery-powered radio works even when the power is off.
opts: 停电时电池收音机仍能工作。
收音机只能在白天使用。
停电时收音机也没用了。
收音机需要插电才能用。

listeningQuestions.audio: Get under a solid table when the ground starts to shake.
opts: 地面开始摇晃时,躲到结实的桌子下。
地面摇晃时立刻跳出窗户。

listeningQuestions.audio: The rescue team pulled three people from the rubble.
opts: 救援队从废墟中救出了三个人。
救援队没有找到任何人。

quizQuestions.q: We must take ____ to protect people from floods.（措施)
Local ____ were moved to safety before the typhoon.（居民)
Hide in a secure ____ during a strong typhoon.（地下室)
Follow the ____ order and leave for higher ground.（撤离)
The little boy was terrified of ____ under the broken wall.
____ everything in the flood, the family had to start again.
____ what to do, many people panicked during the quake.
The captain was praised for ____ all the passengers before the ship sank.
听录音选出正确的中文意思。
opts: 地震可能毫无预警地发生。
地震总是提前一周通知。
地震不会造成任何伤害。
quizQuestions.audio: Earthquakes can strike without any warning.

quizQuestions.q: 听录音选出正确的中文意思。
opts: 灾难时要准备好求生包。
只有医生才需要求生包。
quizQuestions.audio: Keep a survival kit ready in case of a disaster.

reading.passage: During the big flood, a teacher led all her students up to the roof of the school. They waited there calmly until a rescue boat finally arrived. Thanks to her quick thinking, not a single child was hurt.
reading.passageCn: 在那场大洪水中,一位老师把全体学生带到了学校的屋顶。他们在那里镇定地等待,直到一艘救援船终于到来。多亏她反应迅速,没有一个孩子受伤。

questions.q: Where did the teacher lead her students?
opts: To the roof of the school.
Because of the teacher's quick thinking.
Because the flood was very small.
Because they could all swim well.

writing.prompt: Write a short notice (about 60 words) telling classmates how to stay safe in ONE natural disaster, such as an earthquake, a typhoon or a flood. Say what to do before and during it.
writing.promptCn: 写一则约60词的英文须知,告诉同学如何在某一种自然灾害(如地震、台风或洪水)中保护自己,说明灾前和灾中该怎么做。

lines.text: The radio says a typhoon is coming tonight.
lines.cn: 收音机说今晚有台风要来。

lines.text: Then let's fill some bottles with water and find the torch.
lines.cn: 那我们装几瓶水,再找出手电筒吧。

lines.text: Good idea. I'll put fresh batteries in the radio too.
lines.cn: 好主意。我再给收音机换上新电池。

lines.text: With everything ready, we have nothing to fear.
lines.cn: 一切都准备好了,我们就没什么可怕的了。

lines.text: The flood has gone down. What can we do to help?
lines.cn: 洪水退了。我们能做点什么帮忙呢?

lines.text: Let's clear the street and check on the old couple next door.
lines.cn: 我们去清理街道,再看看隔壁的老两口。

lines.text: Having lost so much, they will need our help.
lines.cn: 他们损失了那么多,会需要我们帮忙的。

lines.text: Yes. Together we can rebuild faster.
lines.cn: 是的。齐心协力,我们能更快重建。
